_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Declares FxRevaluationPosting, the append-only audit record produced by OCA\Shillinq\Service\Treasury\FxRevaluationService at period-end (008 of bookkeeping-multi-currency). Fills the SoftCloseExecutor:delegateFxRevaluation call-site (lib/Service/SoftCloseExecutor.php) that has existed since bookkeeping-soft-close-flux shipped but always returned 0 because the delegate class never existed.

FxRevaluationPosting.title: FX Revaluation Posting
FxRevaluationPosting.description: Append-only audit record per FXPosition period-end revaluation. Carries the source position, the closing rate used (and how it was resolved), the incremental unrealised movement posted, and the GL account attribution. Lifecycle: posted → reversed (manual controller correction only — this is NOT an automatic month-start reversal; see design.md 'Reversing-entry vs cumulative-adjustment decision').

administrationId.description: Administration the revalued FXPosition belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

periodId.description: FK to FiscalPeriod.periodId, the yyyy-mm period this revaluation closed.
periodId.title: Period ID

positionId.description: FK to the source FXPosition record revalued.
positionId.title: Position ID

foreignCurrency.description: Foreign currency of the revalued position, ISO 4217.
foreignCurrency.title: Foreign Currency

functionalCurrency.description: Administration's functional currency the position was revalued into, ISO 4217.
functionalCurrency.title: Functional Currency

netPosition.description: Snapshot of FXPosition.position at the moment of revaluation.
netPosition.title: Net Position

priorRate.description: FXPosition.spotRate immediately before this revaluation; null when this is the position's first mark.
priorRate.title: Prior Rate

closingRate.description: Closing rate applied this period, three-decimal FX precision.
closingRate.title: Closing Rate

rateSource.description: Whether closingRate came from a live TreasuryRateService snapshot or the position's manually-maintained spotRate fallback.
rateSource.title: Rate Source

unrealisedDeltaCents.description: Incremental unrealised movement posted this period, in functional-currency integer cents (money-as-cents per ADR-001 fleet rule); positive = gain, negative = loss.
unrealisedDeltaCents.title: Unrealised Delta Cents

direction.description: Sign of unrealisedDeltaCents, denormalised for reporting.
direction.title: Direction

targetGLAccount.description: Unrealised FX gain/loss P&L account this movement is attributed to (fx_revaluation_gain_account / fx_revaluation_loss_account IAppConfig keys).
targetGLAccount.title: Target GL Account

contraGLAccount.description: Balance-sheet FX translation adjustment (contra) account (fx_revaluation_adjustment_account IAppConfig key).
contraGLAccount.title: Contra GL Account

journalEntryId.description: Synthesised journal-entry linkage id for audit trail, mirroring AutoAccrualPosting.journalEntryId — no literal JournalEntry object is created.
journalEntryId.title: Journal Entry ID

reversalId.description: FK to the reversal FxRevaluationPosting once manually reversed by a controller.
reversalId.title: Reversal ID

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Revaluation is live in the trial balance.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Manually reversed by a controller to correct an erroneous automated posting; original entry preserved for audit.

reverse.label: Reverse posting
reverse.description: Mark the revaluation posting as reversed; original entry preserved.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: FxRevaluationPosting is append-only audit evidence / ADR-022 — original posted entry MUST be preserved when a reversal is recorded; the reversal links back to the original via reversalId.
